verdict.rationale: SumUp has an extensive public developer API (checkouts, refunds, webhooks, API keys, SDKs) documented at developer.sumup.com, with a real-world hacker use case confirming external API-driven integration (sumup-comm-1) and code samples (sumup-docs-13, sumup-docs-27) showing programmatic control. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard OpenAPI endpoints) and independent benchmarking of API completeness beyond docs.
